title: Fresh Start
notes: Much simpler start: just pick a name and a power, then jump straight into your first fight.
Features unlock step by step (Inventory, Champion, Gate Map, Legion, Arena) with a clear 'Next unlock' goal.
Big FIGHT button on the home screen. Locked menus are hidden until you need them.
Better gear is equipped automatically and stat points are assigned for you (both can be turned off).
Skills unlock with your level: skill 2 at Lv 3, skill 3 at Lv 5, Ultimate at Lv 2.
Battles continue to the next floor automatically. After a defeat you replay one floor lower.
Faster early levels. Gate D is tougher at floors 8 to 10.
